The difference between e) and f) in English you feel little: in e) is said in what state was the machine at the time of purchase, in f) Which car. (state phrase with its own subject) · ⁧تَحْمِلُ بَاقَةً⁩ (direct imperfection; The girl) · ⁧وَهِيَ تَضْحَكُ⁩ ( ⁧وَ⁩ + pronoun; The girl) · ⁧مُنْدَهِشًا⁩ (word; the boy) · ⁧مَعًا⁩ (adverb; (i) ⁧وَهُوَ يَبْتَسِمُ⁩ ( ⁧وَ⁩ + pronoun; the old) Exercise 8. a) ⁧مُتْعَبَةً⁩ · b) ⁧ضَاحِكِينَ⁩ · c) ⁧مُسْرِعًا⁩ ( o ⁧المُسْرِعَ⁩ ) · d) ⁧وَهُوَ يَبْكِي⁩ · e) ⁧دُونَ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ⁩ · f) ⁧وَحْدَهُ⁩ Exercise 9. a) In a hurry; near the window; He looked at the clock. b) An elder reading the paper alone and a waiter cleaning the tables quietly. c) If he waits for someone; The boy, hesitantly, says to wait for a friend, whom he had an appointment with at 9:00. The elder laughs: it's 9:30, but waiting is part of love. d) Come in carrying a bouquet of roses and laughing; Sorry: the bus was as late as usual. e) Because roses should have been your gift to her. f) The two go out together and the elder returns to his newspaper smiling. Exercise 10. 1. The protesters went down the street with signs on which their demands were written. 2. The delegation arrived at the airport two hours late because of the fog. 3. The minister left the room without answering the questions of journalists. 4. Players returned home after winning the championship for the first time. 5. The audience stood up and applauded when the winner came up on stage. 6. The missing child was found safe and sound after hours of research. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ⁩ it is made with "con" (or "portando"); in 2 ⁧مُتَأَخِّرًا سَاعَتَيْنِ⁩ • with two hours delay • in 4 ⁧وَقَدْ فَازُوا⁩ indicates an already accomplished fact:          • after winning • • from winning • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • in 5 ⁧مُصَفِّقًا⁩ "Applause" / "Applause" means: in 6 ⁧سَالِمًا⁩ is a ḥāl: “safe and sound”.
⁧كُنْتُ أَمْسِ فِي مَحَطَّةِ القِطَارِ أَنْتَظِرُ صَدِيقِي القَادِمَ مِنْ رُومَا. جَلَسْتُ عَلَى مَقْعَدٍ أَقْرَأُ جَرِيدَةً، وَبِجَانِبِي امْرَأَةٌ⁩
⁧كَبِيرَةٌ فِي السِّنِّ تَنْظُرُ إِلَى اللَّوْحَةِ قَلِقَةً. فَجْأَةً وَصَلَ شَابٌّ يَرْكُضُ وَفِي يَدِهِ حَقِيبَةٌ كَبِيرَةٌ، وَسَأَلَنِي وَهُوَ يَتَنَفَّسُ⁩
⁧قُلْتُ لَهُ مُتَأَسِّفًا إِنَّهُ غَادَرَ قَبْلَ دَقِيقَتَيْنِ. جَلَسَ الشَّابُّ حَزِينًا دُونَ أَنْ يَقُولَ⁩ « ⁧هَلْ غَادَرَ قِطَارُ تُورِينُو؟⁩ » ⁧بِصُعُوبَةٍ:⁩
⁧شَيْئًا. بَعْدَ رُبْعِ سَاعَةٍ وَصَلَ قِطَارُ رُومَا، وَنَزَلَ صَدِيقِي مُبْتَسِمًا. خَرَجْنَا مِنَ المَحَطَّةِ مَعًا وَنَحْنُ نَتَحَدَّثُ، وَقَدْ⁩
⁧حَتَّى رَأَيْتُهُ فِي المَقْهَى المُجَاوِرِ جَالِسًا وَحْدَهُ يَشْرَبُ قَهْوَةً.⁩ … ⁧نَسِيتُ الشَّابَّ تَمَامًا⁩

⁧كَبِيرَةٌ فِي السِّنِّ⁩ Older people ⁧اللَّوْحَة⁩ The scoreboard shall be the following: ⁧يَتَنَفَّسُ⁩ Breathe, breathe, breathe. ⁧مُتَأَسِّفًا⁩ "Sorry" is that. Exercise 12. a) Because she couldn't go. He was trying to cook alone in the kitchen. Elena came in with a big cake; Paul came in laughing because he had climbed the five floors on foot (the elevator was still broken). They all ate and chatted together. Together, singing old Arabic songs, and they ran off without turning around. b) The Egyptian film; The director went up to the stage crying with joy. He stood there and applauded for a long time. In the front row, writing fast. The director went to her smiling and told her that she knows her services. Tired but happy. c) 1. A woman by bus: an elder comes up with two heavy suitcases, she gives him the place immediately; ḥāl: ⁧جَالِسَةً⁩ (predicted by ⁧كُنْتُ⁩ ), ⁧أَقْرَأُ⁩ , ⁧يَحْمِلُ⁩ , ⁧مُبَاشَرَةً⁩ , ⁧مُبْتَسِمًا⁩ . 2. A group at the theatre: they arrive at a show started, they come into silence and sit down in the back without disturbing; ḥāl: ⁧وَقَدْ بَدَأَ⁩ , ⁧صَامِتِينَ⁩ , ⁧دُونَ أَنْ نُزْعِجَ⁩ . 3. A parent: the child leaves school running with the result of the exam in his hand and shouts laughing that he has been promoted; ḥāl: ⁧رَاكِضًا⁩ , ⁧وَفِي يَدِهِ وَرَقَةٌ⁩ , ⁧وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ.⁩ Unit verification. 1. ⁧سُعَدَاءَ⁩ · 2. ⁧غَاضِبَةً⁩ · 3. ⁧مَفْتُوحَةً⁩ · 4. ⁧ضَاحِكَاتٍ⁩ · 5. ⁧وَنَحْنُ نُغَنِّي⁩ · 6. ⁧وَهِيَ تَبْكِي⁩ · 7. ⁧جَاءَ يَرْكُضُ⁩ · 8.
